author: Brian Bowman
title: Cardinals post 2-2 record at Bertha-Hewitt tournament - NewsBreak
text:
By Brian Bowman ,
14 hours ago The Upsala Cardinals finished with a 2-2 record at a Bertha-Hewitt tournament on Saturday, Sept. 22.
In pool play, Upsala was defeated 2-0 by Parkers Prairie and 2-0 by Renville County West.
The Cardinals then competed in the Bronze Bracket and won 2-0 over St. Cloud Apollo and Cass Lake.
Upsala team stats from the tournament included serving 130/141, 10 aces, 56 kills, 115 digs, 21 ace blocks, and 48 set assists.
Individual stats were Zoey Leners (27 kills, 11 ace blocks), Alexa Pilarski (21 digs), Lydia Kokett (11 kills), Hannah Heesen (eight kills, 19 digs, serving 23/24, two aces), Genevieve Mrozek (four kills, six set assists), Sierra Bense (38 set assists), and Emily Ripplinger (five kills, 27 digs, serving 27/28, two aces).
Thursday, Sept. 25 saw Upsala lose 3-2 to the Long Prairie-Grey Eagle Thunder by scores of 25-20, 18-25, 21-25, 25-23, 10-15).
Upsala teams stats included serving 86/98 nine aces, 52 kills, six ace blocks, 49 assists, and 112 digs.
Cardinals’ individual stats came from Pilarski (serving 11/11, 12 digs), Mrozek (three kills), Kokett (serving 20/21, seven kills, 31 digs), Isabel Klug (serving 5/6), Bense (35 set assists), Ripplinger (six kills, 22 digs), and Heesen (14 kills, 19 digs).
The Cardinals also lost 3-0 (16-25, 13-25, 17-25) to the Swanville Bulldogs on Tuesday, Sept. 30.
Upsala hosted Osakis on Thursday, Oct. 2, but no score was available at press time.
The Cardinals will visit Browerville on Tuesday, Oct. 7. Game time is 7 p.m.
